:::{#def-newton-raphson}
#### Newton-Raphson algorithm

The **Newton-Raphson algorithm** for solving the score equation
$\score(\param) = 0$
starts from an initial guess $\esttmp{\param}$
and repeats the update

$$
\begin{aligned}
\esttmp{\param}
&\leftarrow \esttmp{\param} - \inv{\hessf{\vx; \esttmp{\param}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\param}}\\
&= \esttmp{\param} + \inv{\oinff{\vx; \esttmp{\param}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\param}}
\end{aligned}
$$

until the estimate stops changing.
:::
